stem: A verified reference shows the room sensor is offset only during lights-on periods. What should the technician investigate before assuming permanent calibration drift?
choices: Radiant exposure, shielding, placement and other condition-dependent measurement effects.
Change the HVAC target to match the offset.
rationale: Radiant exposure, shielding, placement and other condition-dependent measurement effects. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
